chunks: And indeed the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, circumambulated the Kaaba until, when he reached the Yemeni Corner, he raised his head toward the Kaaba and said:

All praise is due to Allah, who has honored you and magnified you. And all praise is due to Allah, who sent me as a Prophet and made ʿAlī an Imam. O Allah, guide to him the best of Your creation, and keep away from him the worst of Your creation.

key_terms.الرُّكْنَ الْيَمَانِيَّ: the Yemeni Corner of the Kaaba
key_terms.اللَّهُمَّ: O Allah, a form of direct supplication
key_terms.الْكَعْبَةِ: the Kaaba, the sacred House around which tawaf is performed
key_terms.نَبِيًّا: a Prophet, one sent by Allah with divine mission

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله say at the Yemeni Corner about the Kaaba and Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله making du'a at the Kaaba during tawaf, praising Allah for the sanctity of the Kaaba and for his own prophethood. It also explicitly mentions Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام as Imam and includes a supplication that the best of creation be guided to him and that the worst be kept away from him.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.2295 - The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) circumambulated the Kaaba, and when he reached the Yemeni Corner, He (sw) raised his head toward the Kaaba and said:
"All praise is due to Allah (swt), who has honored and magnified you.

All praise is due to Allah (swt), who sent me as a prophet and made Ali an imam. O Allah (swt), guide for him the best of Your creation and keep him away from the worst of Your creation."
[Chapter=CHAPTER 64 - CHAPTER ON THE ORIGIN OF THE KAABA, ITS VIRTUE, AND THE VIRTUE OF THE HARAM (SACRED SANCTUARY)]
بَابُ ابْتِدَاءِ الْكَعْبَةِ وَفَضْلِهَا وَفَضْلِ الْحَرَمِ
